text: Broken board (debris-9) reported 0.5m dead ahead near the cabin door (x1.31 z3.43, yaw 134). Pressing E does nothing and gives no message; nothing visible on screen to pick up. Crosshair says Log wall.

Holding broom (1) with crosshair visibly on bare floorboards, the target label says 'Fallen shingle' (a shingle ~1m off-centre) and 10s of left-mouse sweeping did nothing: floorClean stayed 8%, no message why. Debris aim-assist seems to steal the floor target from the broom.

Sweeping is per-spot: each 2-3 s of broom work cleans one small patch then says 'Clean here. Move on.' Six patches took the floor from 9% to 22%, so the whole floor needs ~30+ reposition-and-hold cycles; holding the mouse while walking did not sweep a trail (position did not change during mousehold+strafe).

E silently does nothing when debris is close at your feet but the view is level-ish: fallen shingle 0.9m away at bearing -2 deg, pitch -42 deg, crosshair label 'Floorboards' (not in reach); E gave no pickup and no message. Tilting to pitch -71 so the label read 'Fallen shingle' made E work. The horizontal 12-deg leniency does not seem to cover pitch, and a failed E has no 'nothing in reach' feedback. Screenshot shots/e_silent.png (tick ~9555).

Standing 1.1m from the wagon (after walking up to it), the camera is inside/against wagon geometry: the screen is large flat brown/green shapes and a post, the wagon and its load are not recognisable. Label 'Your wagon' still shows.
